title: Δεινόσαυρος καὶ Πάνδα
learning_goal: Practice third-person present movement and location patterns (e.g., ἐξέρχεται, εἰσέρχονται, εἰς/ἐκ/ἐν/πρὸς/παρά) together with hide-and-seek verbs (κλέπτει, ζητεῖ, κρύπτει, εὑρίσκει) using concrete objects like the apple, ball, and chest.
plot: Dinosaur and Panda spend a day together; Korax steals Panda’s apple, they search and find it hidden in a chest, and they finish the day safely at home.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς κλίνης.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur goes out of the bed.
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the left side of the cozy bedroom, stepping down from the bed with one foot on the floor and one foot still near the mattress edge.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Πάνδα ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς κλίνης.
frames.text_english: The Panda goes out of the bed.
positioning: Panda stands on the right side of the bedroom, climbing down carefully from the bed with both paws reaching toward the floor.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐσθίει τὸν ἄρτον, καὶ ὁ Πάνδα πίνει τὸ ὕδωρ.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur eats the bread, and the Panda drinks the water.
objects: a small round loaf of bread with a golden crust
a plain clay cup with clear water
positioning: Dinosaur sits on the left side of the round wooden table, leaning forward toward the bread.
Panda sits on the right side of the table, looking at the cup of water.
The small round loaf of bread with a golden crust rests on the table in front of Dinosaur.
The plain clay cup with clear water sits on the table in front of Panda.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Πάνδα ἔχει τὸ μῆλον, καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἔχει τὴν σφαῖραν.
frames.text_english: The Panda has the apple, and the Dinosaur has the ball.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Panda stands by the open doorway on the right holding something close to his chest.
Dinosaur stands to the left of Panda with his arm relaxed at his side.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is in Panda’s right paw.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam is in Dinosaur’s left hand.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος καὶ ὁ Πάνδα ἐξέρχονται ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur and the Panda go out of the house.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Panda steps through the doorway to the right, looking outside.
Dinosaur follows just behind on the left, heading toward the sunlight.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is held in Panda’s right paw as he steps out.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam is carried in Dinosaur’s left hand as he follows.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος παίζει μετὰ τῆς σφαίρας, καὶ ὁ Πάνδα ἔχει τὸ μῆλον.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur plays with the ball, and the Panda has the apple.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur stands on the left of the cobblestone path, mid-kick toward the right.
Panda stands on the right near the shady tree, watching the play.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is held against Panda’s belly with both paws.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam rolls from Dinosaur toward the center of the path.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ προσέρχεται πρὸς τὸν Πάνδαν.
frames.text_english: The Korax comes toward the Panda.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur stands on the left, turning his head toward Panda and Korax.
Panda stands on the right beneath the low branches, holding the apple up.
Korax swoops low from the upper right toward Panda with wings slightly open.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is in Panda’s paws, held forward.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam rests on the ground near Dinosaur’s feet.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ κλέπτει τὸ μῆλον, καὶ ὁ Πάνδα λυπεῖται.
frames.text_english: The Korax steals the apple, and the Panda is sad.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur stands to the left, surprised and turning toward the action.
Panda stands on the right with paws outstretched in dismay.
Korax is in the center-right, pulling away with the apple in his beak.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is clutched in Korax’s beak as he lifts away.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam lies on the path near Dinosaur.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ζητεῖ τὸν Κόρακα, καὶ ὁ Πάνδα ζητεῖ τὸ μῆλον.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur seeks the Korax, and the Panda seeks the apple.
objects: a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur stands on the left, peering along the path toward the distance.
Panda kneels on the right, looking around the base of the tree.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam rests near Dinosaur’s left foot on the cobblestones.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ κρύπτει τὸ μῆλον ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ.
frames.text_english: The Korax hides the apple in the chest.
objects: a medium brown wooden chest with a brass latch
a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Korax crouches at the right side of the path, leaning over an open chest.
The medium brown wooden chest with a brass latch sits open on the ground under a low branch.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is placed inside the open chest.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam sits unattended on the left side of the scene near the path edge.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος εὑρίσκει τὴν κιβωτόν, καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος εὑρίσκει τὸ μῆλον ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur finds the chest, and the Dinosaur finds the apple in the chest.
objects: a medium brown wooden chest with a brass latch
a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur kneels at the center, opening the chest and reaching inside.
Panda stands to the right of Dinosaur, leaning forward to look into the chest.
Korax perches on a low branch in the upper left, watching the scene.
The medium brown wooden chest with a brass latch is open in front of Dinosaur.
The round green apple with a short brown stem rests inside the open chest near Dinosaur’s hand.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam lies on the ground just behind Dinosaur.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Πάνδα χαίρει, καὶ ὁ Κόραξ λυπεῖται.
frames.text_english: The Panda rejoices, and the Korax is sad.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the center, smiling toward Panda.
Panda stands on the right holding the apple up with a happy face.
Korax stands on the left ground with head lowered and wings slightly drooped.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is raised in Panda’s right paw.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam rests by Dinosaur’s feet.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος καὶ ὁ Πάνδα εἰσέρχονται εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur and the Panda go into the house.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a small red leather ball with a stitched seam
positioning: Dinosaur steps through the doorway first from the right into the cozy interior.
Panda follows close behind, looking inside.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is carried in Panda’s left paw as he enters.
The small red leather ball with a stitched seam is tucked under Dinosaur’s right arm as he enters.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Πάνδα ἐσθίει τὸ μῆλον παρὰ τὴν τράπεζαν, καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος πίνει τὸ ὕδωρ.
frames.text_english: The Panda eats the apple at the table, and the Dinosaur drinks the water.
objects: a round green apple with a short brown stem
a plain clay cup with clear water
positioning: Panda sits on the right side of the table, raising the apple toward his mouth.
Dinosaur sits on the left side of the table, leaning toward the cup.
The round green apple with a short brown stem is in Panda’s right paw above the table.
The plain clay cup with clear water sits in front of Dinosaur’s hands.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἔχει τὸ βιβλίον, καὶ ὁ Πάνδα μένει παρὰ τὴν θύραν.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur has the book, and the Panda stays by the door.
objects: a simple blue-covered book with a white label on the front
positioning: Dinosaur sits on a low bench near the center holding a book on his lap.
Panda stands to the right near the wooden door, looking toward Dinosaur.
The simple blue-covered book with a white label on the front rests open in Dinosaur’s hands.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος καθεύδει ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ.
frames.text_english: The Dinosaur sleeps in the bed.
positioning: Dinosaur lies under a blanket on the left side of the small wooden bed with eyes closed.

frames.text_koine: ὁ Πάνδα καθεύδει ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ.
frames.text_english: The Panda sleeps in the bed.
positioning: Panda curls up peacefully on the right side of the bed with the blanket pulled to his chin.
